summary: 14/16 steps pass on the primary image+symptoms path; steps 14-15 fail when Image AI predicts Healthy and dilutes the fused score below High, so no disease_case is created. Re-test without image (or with High fused score) unlocks the full vet triage path.

credentials_used.note: README credentials (farmer_a, vet_officer, admin_user) return 401 against the live sandbox DB

results.name: Farmer logs in
results.evidence: POST /api/auth/login HTTP 200; Ramesh Patil (FARMER); JWT issued

results.name: Registers a cow
results.evidence: POST /api/animals HTTP 201; animal_id=TAG-PUN-2026-BAVF7 (and later TAG-PUN-2026-MNTT4 for high-risk path)

results.name: QR code is generated
results.evidence: qr_code_identifier + base64 + file under /uploads/qrcodes/; GET /api/animals/qr/{token} HTTP 200

results.name: Farmer opens Animal Health Passport
results.evidence: GET /api/animals/{id}/passport HTTP 200; passport_metadata + farmer/ai/vet tiers present

results.name: Farmer reports symptoms
results.evidence: POST /api/reports/health accepted symptoms list; report_id returned

results.name: Image AI runs
results.evidence: MobileNetV3-Small inference; predicted_class=Healthy, confidence=0.9988, risk_score=0.1, quality_check_passed=True

results.name: Symptom AI runs
results.evidence: XGBoost+SHAP; top_condition=Lumpy Skin Disease; risk_score=91.5 (with image path) / 61.8 (symptoms-only high-risk path)

results.name: Multi-modal risk score is generated
results.evidence: With healthy image: final=47.0 Medium (surveillance NOT triggered). Without image: final=60.9 High (surveillance triggered). Score lives primarily under multi_modal_risk (HealthReportOut omits top-level final_risk_score).

results.name: High-risk report appears in surveillance system
results.evidence: Surveillance map API works (vet saw high/critical markers). Primary image+symptoms report was Medium so did not escalate. Symptoms-only High report TAG-PUN-2026-MNTT4 appeared on map with risk_level=High, is_surveillance_triggered=true.

results.name: Multiple simulated reports trigger cluster detection
results.evidence: POST /api/clusters/detect HTTP 200; 2 Emerging Risk Pattern clusters; seeded 3 extra animals; first cluster_46763db30d6b with report_count=4

results.name: Veterinarian sees the case
results.evidence: FAIL on image-diluted Medium path (GET /api/cases returned []). PASS on High path: case 689e77fc-42f8-492b-acb8-c77503ef8d8c PENDING_REVIEW for Lumpy Skin Disease / TAG-PUN-2026-MNTT4

results.name: Veterinarian reviews the AI assessment
results.evidence: Blocked when no case exists. On High path: vet fetched multi_modal_risk via report; PUT /api/cases/{id}/verify HTTP 200; status updated to VERIFIED

results.name: Alert is generated
results.evidence: Role alerts present: HIGH_RISK_ASSESSMENT (farmer), HIGH_RISK_REPORT_REVIEW (vet), POTENTIAL_DISEASE_CLUSTER, REGIONAL_DISEASE_RISK
